content: Gāzurgāhī's short entry on Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī centres on two amorous ghazals and stresses his originality as a thinker (MK's reading): his treatises contain much that has occurred to no one else; works listed include Kunh al-Murād, Ḥulal-i Muṭarraz, Ḥaqāyiq al-Tahlīl, Mavāṭin and a Sharḥ of the Burda.
